In Zao, the lizard {npc:Zalamon} leads a resistance against the undead dragon emperor. You help the resistance spy on the enemy in the Muggy Plains: you steal a tactical map, investigate the Temple of Equilibrium, spy on the village of Chaochai, poison the rice fields, solve the lever puzzle and survive the Phantom Army. You get 10,000 experience, {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}, the {item:Serpent Crest} (2nd addon of the Warmaster Outfits) and access to daily and weekly tasks.
Zalamon, far east of Zao (1 floor down)

Access to Zalamon's (and Chartan's) daily and weekly tasks
After finishing the quest (mission 5, Phantom Army): daily **Zzuppliezz** and weekly **Zze Art of War**.
After the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} you lose access to {npc:Zalamon} and ask {npc:Chartan} for the tasks, who also has the daily **Collect**.
Nobori addon of the Warmaster Outfits
At the end of mission 5 you receive the {item:Serpent Crest}, which you swap for the addon with {npc:Cael}, in Farmine.
You need this quest completed and the daily task **Zzuppliezz**.
Zalamon speaks with "zz" in place of "s", but the keywords you have to say are normal: {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Get ready for lots of {wiki:High Class Lizards|high-class lizards} (especially {creature:Lizard Zaogun|Lizard Zaoguns}) throughout the quest.
In mission 3, after you poison the rice, go straight on to the mission 4 building and go down to the basement: you get that mission's message and save yourself a trip.
Zalamon is at the far east of Zao, one floor below ground. To earn his trust you have to bring him documents from the enemy.

{npc:Zalamon} is at the far **east** of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, 1 floor below ground. To get there, take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch} (far below Kazordoon) or {npc:Gurbasch} (8 floors below Cormaya), with {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:yes}. In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the lift takes you to the surface of the mountain. Follow the passage **east**, going down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/crates), until you come out on the Zao Steppe. Then cross the steppe **east** to Zalamon.
Exit of the mountain passage (entrance to the Zao Steppe)

To go back to Farmine, do the route in reverse: climb the mountain on the passage (with {spell:Levitate}) and head **west** to the lift. On the steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon ({key:kazordoon}) or to Cormaya ({key:cormaya}).
Go and see {npc:Zalamon}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} twice to accept the first task: find documents about the lizards' strategies at an outpost beyond the mountains.
Use the teleport that leads to the area **north of the Dragonblaze Peaks** and keep heading to the **far east**. You find a small lizard camp.
Teleport to the north of the Dragonblaze Peaks
There are {creature:Lizard Zaogun|Lizard Zaoguns} and other {wiki:High Class Lizards|High Class Lizards} in the camp.
Go into the **first building** you see and search the shelves: the {item:Tactical Map} is there.
You have **less than 1 hour** to deliver the map to Zalamon. If you take longer, you have to restart the mission.
Go back through the same teleport to the Zao Steppe and head **east** to Zalamon. Say {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} to give him the documents.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Zalamon asks you to investigate the **Temple of Equilibrium** and marks it on your map.
Go to the **Temple of Equilibrium**. Climb the stairs to the top and go down to the bottom on the other side. You will face many {creature:Lizard Zaogun|Lizard Zaoguns} and other lizards.

To save supplies killing Lizard Zaoguns on the way up, go up only the first floor and use {spell:Levitate} to get across to the other side, at the spot of the red circle in the image. On the way down you meet 2 {creature:Lizard Zaogun|Lizard Zaoguns} and 1 {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest}, but you can run to the stairs and go up straight afterwards.
Use Levitate at the spot marked with the red circle
Behind the pair of stairs you came down there are some **hidden stairs**. Go down them: below there are 5 {creature:Lizard Chosen}. A red message appears saying you passed.
You can go straight back up so the Lizard Chosen do not hit you.
Leave the temple using the {item:Vines|vines} at this spot and go back to Zalamon (through the teleport back to the Zao Steppe and then **east**).

Say {key:mission} to report what you saw in the temple and then {key:mission} and {key:yes} again. Zalamon marks the entrance to **Chaochai** on your map and asks you to spy on the lizards' weapons, food and forces.
Go to **Chaochai**, the small camp north of the Dragonblaze Peaks. Go into the food warehouse, on the ground floor. A red message appears.
Mission 2: the buildings to visit in Chaochai
Go down to the basement of the weapons warehouse. You have to break some {item:Wooden Bars} with a melee weapon to get in. Another red message appears.
Go into the barracks, on the ground floor, and receive the third red message.

Do not forget: in the **northeasternmost** building, one floor up, there is a chest with a {item:Tome of Knowledge}. Open it and then go back to Zalamon: leave Chaochai the same way and return to the Zao Steppe through the teleport you came by.
Say {key:mission} to report what you saw in Chaochai. Then say {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}: you have to poison the rice fields that feed the army.
Go to Zalamon's storeroom, **west of the stairs**, and pick up the {item:Flask of Poison}.
Use the teleport to the **Muggy Plains** and head **east** to the rice fields. Go to the **uppermost rice field (top terrace)** and use the {item:Flask of Poison} on any spot of the water.
Use the poison on the water of the upper rice field

Before you go back, head **northeast** to the mission 4 building. Go in and down to the basement: you receive the red message for the next mission. Then go back up the same way, return to the Zao Steppe through the teleport and say {key:mission} to Zalamon to finish mission 3.
The basement of the mission 4 building
Say {key:mission} twice and {key:yes}. Zalamon asks you to look for a passage to the Great Gate in the north of the valley.

(If you already did this during mission 3, skip this step.) From the teleport in the Muggy Plains head **east**, passing the rice fields to the **northeast**. Go up the stairs and follow the mountain gorge (where there is 1 {creature:Mutated Tiger}). Keep going up until you enter a building and go down the stairs as far as possible, to a room with **strange symbols**. A red message appears.
The strange symbols on the floor below: this is the arrangement to reproduce
Near this place there are many High Class Lizards and also {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers}, {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats} and {creature:Death Blob|Death Blobs}.
Go back to Zalamon and say {key:strange symbols} and {key:yes}. He explains that it is a puzzle and that the levers need oil.
In Zalamon's storeroom, take the {item:Flask of Extra Greasy Oil} from a {item:Small Bamboo Shelf}.

Go back to the building in the Muggy Plains, to the room with the levers. Use the oil on the levers and then **use the levers** so that the symbols in the centre of the room match the symbols you saw on the floor below. When it is right, a red message appears.
Use the oil on the levers
The levers and the symbols in the centre of the room
Report and get the Tome of Knowledge
Go back to Zalamon and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you a {item:Tome of Knowledge}.

You need a group of **4 players**. Players who have already done this part can help by asking Zalamon for {key:task} and choosing {key:Zztrike}; whoever has already completed the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} has to ask {npc:Chartan} for the Zztrike task.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Zalamon sends you through the portal to the Great Gate.
In the previous mission's building you can now go down further: you find a room with a **blue flame** teleport. Step into it with the group.
Occupy the houses without a statue
On the other side, each player has to stand still in a house where a **lizard statue is missing**, for 10 to 30 seconds. Everyone sees a message saying they hear "distant clicks".
The houses without a statue where each player must stand
Go up the stairs to the south
All players walk **south** to some stairs and go up.
There is a time limit: if you take too long to go up the stairs, you can no longer continue.
Survive the Phantom Army for 10 minutes

Up there the Phantom Army spawns: {creature:Eternal Guardian|Eternal Guardians} and {creature:Lizard Chosen}. Hide in the **southwest** or **northeast** part of the area and block the way with {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bomb Runes} to avoid the fight. After you survive **10 minutes**, Zalamon teleports you out; if you end up in the Muggy Plains, go back to the Zao Steppe through the teleport and head **east** to Zalamon.
One of the spots where you can protect yourself with Fire Bomb Runes
Use Levitate here to stay away from the monsters
Levitate spot in the easternmost house
In the easternmost house there is a spot where you can use {spell:Levitate} ({key:exani hur up}) and stay completely out of the creatures' way.
There is a {item:Tome of Knowledge} in a chest in the building on the **east** side of the path that leads to the gate (south of where you start).
Report and get the Serpent Crest
Talk to Zalamon and say {key:mission}. He gives you the {item:Serpent Crest} as a sign of respect. The quest is complete.
Serpent Crest (2nd addon of the Warmaster Outfits) and 10,000 experience points

After you finish, Zalamon offers a daily task and a weekly one. Anyone who completes the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} loses access to Zalamon and starts asking for these tasks from {npc:Chartan} (in the {wiki:Rebel Camp}), who also has an extra daily task.
Say {key:supplies} to Zalamon and accept the mission (to Chartan: {key:task} and {key:zzuppliezz}).
Go to the lizard village of Chaochai (the one from mission 2), go down a floor and use the lizards' weapon rack to get a {item:Weapons Crate (Set)|Weapons Crate}.
The weapon rack on the lower floor
Look for some {item:Fish|fish} hanging on a wall and use them: you get two {item:Corned Fish}.
The fish hanging on the wall

On the **east** side of the village, say {key:hi} to the {npc:Lizard Prisoner|Lizard Prisoners} and use **just one** {item:Corned Fish} on the wall where they are imprisoned. You get the **Vive la Resistance** achievement.
The wall where the Lizard Prisoners are imprisoned
Use only one fish: you have to hand the other one to Zalamon.

Go back to Zalamon (or Chartan) with the Weapons Crate and the other Corned Fish, say {key:supplies} and confirm with {key:yes}. You receive a random reward: {item:Red Gem}, {item:Green Gem}, {item:Blue Gem} or {item:Zaoan Armor}.
Red Gem, Green Gem, Blue Gem or Zaoan Armor

Only after the Wrath of the Emperor Quest. Talk to {npc:Chartan}, in the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp} (beneath the Souleater Mountains, in the north of Zao), and say {key:task}, {key:collect} and {key:yes}. You have to collect seven items by using various plants in the north of Zao, all in the area above where Chartan is. There are several plants of each type and you can gather them in any order.
Use one plant of each type to get the seven items. These are the locations of at least one of each.
Daily Collect: eat and hand in
Say {key:hi} to Chartan, **eat all** seven strange items and only then say {key:collect}. You get the **Extreme Degustation** achievement and choose a reward according to your vocation.

Ask Zalamon for the {key:strike} mission (or Chartan, if you no longer have access to Zalamon). It is the same as mission 5 (Phantom Army): you can help other players, pick up the Tome of Knowledge and/or kill the boss {creature:Lizard Gate Guardian}. It can be repeated after **6 days and 20 hours**.
Being able to ask Chartan for tasks means Zalamon is no longer accessible to you: from then on all tasks are with Chartan.
The Serpent Crest is the 2nd addon of the {wiki:Warmaster Outfits}.
